findings.quote: a 5.0 mL wheaton microreactor was charged
findings.message: The plan does not explicitly preserve the identity and capacity of the vessel used for charging and reaction.

findings.quote: The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.
findings.message: The initial Stir step encodes duration but not the stated room-temperature condition. No numeric temperature should be inferred.

findings.quote: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
findings.message: The heating step preserves temperature and duration but does not explicitly represent placement into an already preheated aluminum block.
The plan omits the GC/MS completion assessment preceding solvent removal.

findings.quote: THF was removed under reduced pressure
findings.message: Reduced pressure appears in the evidence and uncertainties but is not encoded as an operating condition of the evaporation step.

findings.quote: dried on an oil bath at 90 oC for 30 minutes
findings.message: The final HeatChill step preserves temperature and duration but does not explicitly distinguish drying on an oil bath from generic heating.

value.evidence: a 5.0 mL wheaton microreactor was charged
value.reason: Preserve the charging and reaction vessel as a 5.0 mL wheaton microreactor.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: After capping, place the microreactor into an aluminum block already preheated to 80 °C.
GC/MS is used to judge completion before THF removal.
